decisions.D1_native_not_ota: Real device GPS = native APK build, NOT OTA. released stays false until the founder builds + installs the APK.
decisions.D2_ota_safe_guard: geolocation import is guarded (try/require + runtime check) so the JS is safe even if it rides an OTA before the APK — current users fall back to the default location.
decisions.D3_auto_wire: useLocation upgrades to real GPS when the module is present → Home + Category + the location POST get real coords automatically (no per-screen change).

notes: Contract 3 of the location/distance feature. Adds @react-native-community/geolocation (native) + utils/geolocation.js (OTA-safe loader + Android permission) + useLocation upgrade (default → real GPS when available). No backend change. Builds on follower-location-distance (C1) + follower-location-distance-mobile (C2).
